scope: Known input flags for the proposed daily 2020-2026 proxy. Original inputs are preserved.

findings.status: confirmed duplicate dividend in Yahoo adjusted prices; separate corrected series created
findings.issuer_evidence: Issuer distribution table contains one GBP 0.2025 distribution with ex-date 2024-11-14 and pay date 2024-11-27.
findings.vendor_evidence: Yahoo chart data includes GBP 0.2025 on both 2024-11-14 and 2024-11-15; the adjusted-close jump includes both entries. Raw 2024-11-14 close GBP 9.9350004196167.
findings.correction: Multiply levels on and after 2024-11-15 by 1 - 0.2025 / 9.9350004196167; preserve the 2024-11-14 real dividend. This changes only the 2024-11-15 daily return; subsequent levels are rescaled.
findings.limitations: 2025 performance discrepancy persists. Market closes and issuer NAV can differ; no validated cause established and no further correction applied. Other vendor errors may remain.

findings.status: pre-2020 2009 missing-dividend concern remains uncorrected; excluded from daily sample
findings.evidence: On 2009-05-15 unadjusted closes fell EUR 3.77 and 4.28 respectively; Yahoo returned no dividend events for May 2009. Third-party distribution listings show 2009-05-15 distributions of EUR 3.795 and 4.126 respectively. They are consistent with the flagged drops, but amount treatment and exact adjustment still need independent issuer reconciliation.
findings.limitations: The suspect 2009 observations are not used in the 2020-2026 study; do not infer that the rest of the vendor history is verified.
